name: jurnool
description: Record spending and income in your Jurnool account from a chat, and see your summary, dompet balances and budgets.

interface.longDescription:
Jurnool is a personal finance journal for people who track their money in Indonesian rupiah. Tell ChatGPT what you spent or earned, in your own words or with a receipt photo, and Jurnool records it in your Jurnool account with its amount, category, dompet (wallet) and date. A note Jurnool reads without guessing is saved straight away and can be undone; a note with a guess waits for you to confirm it. You can also ask for your spending summary for a week, month or year, your recent journal entries, your budgets and each dompet's balance.

Jurnool only records what you tell it. It never moves money or makes payments. Budgets and settings are changed in the Jurnool app. You need a Jurnool account and sign in once when ChatGPT asks.

positive.description: Save a note Jurnool reads without guessing
positive.prompt: Catat kopi 25rb dan parkir 5rb di Jurnool
positive.expected_behavior: Saves two expenses in the account's default dompet (BCA in the demo account), coffee Rp 25.000 and parking Rp 5.000. The card shows "Tersimpan" with a "Batalkan jurnal" button.

positive.description: Undo the save from the first case
positive.expected_behavior: Removes both expenses saved in the first case and says they were undone. Nothing else in the account changes.
Lists this week's journal entries from the demo account with their amounts, newest first.
Shows this month's spending, income and largest categories in a summary card. The month follows the account's pay day, as in the Jurnool app.
Shows each dompet with its balance and the total balance in a dompet card.

negative.description: A question unrelated to personal finance records

negative.expected_behavior: Jurnool asks for the amount and saves nothing until it is given.

negative.description: Changing a budget, which is done in the Jurnool app
negative.expected_behavior: Says the budget cannot be changed from ChatGPT and is changed in the Jurnool app. No budget changes.

review.commerce_description: Jurnool sells nothing in ChatGPT and shows no plans or prices.

publication.release_notes: First release: record spending and income from a chat or a receipt photo, undo a save, and see your summary, journal entries, budgets and dompet balances.

id-ID.subtitle: Catat keuangan lewat chat
id-ID.description:
Jurnool adalah jurnal keuangan pribadi dalam rupiah. Ceritakan pengeluaran atau pemasukanmu ke ChatGPT dengan kata-katamu sendiri atau foto struk, lalu Jurnool mencatatnya di akun Jurnool-mu lengkap dengan nominal, kategori, dompet, dan tanggal. Catatan yang terbaca tanpa tebakan langsung tersimpan dan bisa dibatalkan. Catatan yang masih ada tebakan menunggu kamu cek dulu. Kamu juga bisa minta rekap pengeluaran minggu, bulan, atau tahun ini, jurnal terbaru, budget, dan saldo tiap dompet.

Jurnool hanya mencatat apa yang kamu ceritakan. Jurnool tidak memindahkan uang dan tidak membayar apa pun. Budget dan pengaturan diubah di aplikasi Jurnool. Kamu perlu akun Jurnool dan cukup masuk sekali saat ChatGPT memintanya.
